query:
UPDATE log_file SET indexed_at = now()
         FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) AS c(hostname, file_path)
         WHERE log_file.indexed_at IS NULL
           AND log_file.hostname = c.hostname
           AND log_file.file_path = c.file_path
           AND ($3::timestamp IS NULL OR log_file.log_ts <= $3)
